verdict.rationale: Atlas is an incorporation and compliance platform, so letting an agent prepare annual reports or compliance filings is a fair question. The evidence shows only that Atlas itself files 83(b) elections and obtains EINs at signup, which is service-side filing, not agent delegation. There is no documented API, MCP server, or agent workflow for annual reports or ongoing compliance, and the OpenAPI probe found nothing (all candidate paths returned 404). The llms.txt file only serves documentation to AI tools, an adjacent feature that earns no credit here.
